title: Review per-configuration qualification outcomes
description:
Assemble and obtain human review of per-configuration qualification dispositions from applicable rf.04-.11 results and authority.12. Separate baseline from wider-plan, narrowband, microfragment and LR-FHSS claims. Identify evidence invalidated by changes to build, waveform, board, modem firmware, antenna or host integration.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Review only, not automatic activation or permission for future RF sessions. Depend on concrete measurement and authority leaves, never an entire parent or optional filing authority.13. New filing evidence needs human re-review. Publication remains with the existing CCP2 evidence/documentation owner.
acceptance_criteria: Each configuration separately records policy, wire, integration, RF-measured and authorization-reviewed status with reproducible evidence or explicit not-assessed/no-go. Missing evidence and excluded equipment are not passes. A favorable qualification review does not authorize operation. For any positive approval of activation or execution: Require recorded, scoped, explicit approval from Mark for the named action. Applicable authority must also exist. Unsupported experiments remain disabled and do not silently become baseline requirements.
